profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Disney Parks, Experiences and Products

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop and maintain the search functionality for a myriad of Disney websites belonging to their world class parks, resorts, and cruise line. This is done in multiple different languages and locales, utilizing Elasticsearch, Oracle Endeca, and Microsoft Fast technologies for the search engine. This entails troubleshooting and resolving website defects pertaining to search, rolling out support for additional languages/locales, utilizing the web crawler to gather data to be made searchable, relevancy tuning, creating synonyms for commonly used words, modifying/maintaining the pipeline for multiple applications, managing multiple development environments, leading daily SCRUM meetings, conducting/participating in code reviews, interfacing with multiple different teams to help create a holistic web and mobile experience, creating/modifying documentation in JIRA tickets and the Wiki, being on call to handle critical production defects, managing production releases of code modifications conducting/participating in code reviews, creating/modifying documentation in JiRA tickets and the Wiki, being on call to handle critical production defects, managing production releases of new code/modifications to Endeca configuration files every two weeks (two week Agile Development Sprints)

positions.title: Search Consultant
positions.description: Work with clients to develop innovative search solutions at scale. Primarily focused on Elasticsearch (including all products within the Elastic Stack) and OpenSearch (including additional AWS products such as CloudWatch for logs/metrics).

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Develop innovative, custom software that solves complex issues. This entails utilizing the agile methodology to deliver well tested software quickly. The services offered encompass the entire Software Development Lifecycle from analysis/requirements gathering to coding, testing, and delivering an enterprise-grade product.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Assist the U.S. Navy in updating their personnel portal. My specific tasks included maintaining the emulator application which emulated the transactions between the web front-end and the database back-end, and creating automated testing for the web front-end.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Assist the U.S. Census Bureau’s Technology Management Office in creating and implementing an architecture that adheres to their mission goals. This entailed all parts of the software life-cycle including creating documentation and offering support, research and analysis, generating reports, conducting trade studies, scoping development tasks, creating architecture and data flow diagrams, creating training materials, and any other required support. Some projects include a web services trade study: load test a simple web service application on several web servers to see which performs better; Communications Manager: a cross platform library built for iOS, Windows, and Android written in the native languages (Objective-C, C#, and Java) that handled encryption and authentication; Communications Manager Service: a windows service that serviced requests from other applications using IPC mechanisms such as named pipes to connect users to the VPN when the application needed to transmit data.

positions.title: Technical Support Analyst
positions.description: Troubleshoot DSL connections, internet connectivity issues, email clients, etc. Remove malware/spyware. Install drivers and applications. Open ports and change firewall settings.

projects.title: Gigasearch Search Consultancy
projects.description: After reviewing a client’s use case, we give recommendations on the number and types of nodes, amount of CPU/RAM per node, index creation and ILM/ISM, index settings/mappings, cluster settings, search queries and relevancy improvements, monitoring, alerting and visualizations, etc. I have also assisted in architecting new search solutions and the migration/expansion of existing solutions. For example, we have migrated from an outdated on-prem Elasticsearch solution to a SaaS OpenSearch solution. Some issues that we have solutioned for include slow query response times, oversized/undersized shards, multi-tenancy, high storage usage, cluster migrations, custom monitoring and visualization solutions, and upgrade plans for new major release versions.

projects.title: Search Indexing Service
projects.description: Developed in Java (JDK 11) using IntelliJ. This is a Spring Batch application that acts as a REST based web client. It has both a push and pull model where some data is pushed to the application via the REST endpoints while the rest of the data is pulled from various sources. The data is processed in JSON format to be consumed by the search engine. Once downloaded the data is manipulated as needed, for example, splitting a comma separated list of keywords into a String Array to allow each keyword to be searched separately.
